check.notes: No text, logos or watermark anywhere. The shoe, drip and cake form one connected group: the drip from the heel becomes a red pitchfork whose tines go into the cake. This is a deliberate surreal device but reads as melted, liquid red. The heel tip and the start of the drip blend a little where they meet at about x 45-47, y 26-30. The shoe floats with no shadow on the backdrop. The glaze is very glossy and slightly CG-looking. The cake crumb and the stand look clean, with no obvious artefacts. The whole right side (x 58-100) and the top-left corner are empty white space, usable for copy.

issues.what: Faint grey rectangular patches and ghost texture visible behind shoe and cake (x≈70–730, y≈200–1100); image box edges show.
issues.fix_in_canva: Replace with a clean cut-out on pure white, or run Background Remover and set page fill to #FFFFFF.

issues.what: adapt: the reference's devil-tail arrow on the V of DEVIL is missing, so the type loses its visual device.
issues.fix_in_canva: Add a thin #340A5C devil-tail arrow rising from the V's right stroke, matching the reference angle.

issues.what: adapt: the reference shoe is huge, cropped and enters from the top-left. Here it's a small, whole shoe floating mid-frame.
issues.fix_in_canva: Scale the shoe up about 40% and angle the sole diagonally from the top-left, keeping the toe 100px inside the edge.

issues.what: adapt: the reference type hierarchy uses colour contrast (accent THE/EATS against dark DEVIL/BISCOFF). Here THE/EATS are a thin, pale purple and read weak.
issues.fix_in_canva: Set THE/EATS to Inter SemiBold in #FFC107-dark or #4B2386 at full opacity, and keep DEVIL/CAKE Bold #340A5C.

issues.what: adapt: the support line changed job. The reference is a spoken punchline; 'A world of choices' is a short tagline.
issues.fix_in_canva: Use a plain spoken line of similar length that pays off the cake, e.g. 'Go on. Everybody wants a slice.'

issues.what: Cake plate left edge (~103px) and shoe toe (~105px) sit right at the 100px margin limit.
issues.fix_in_canva: Nudge the product group 15–20px right so every object clears 100px with some room.

issues.what: Cake looks generated, not a verified Kapruka listing photo; I can't confirm it matches the real product.
issues.fix_in_canva: Swap in the actual Kapruka chocolate cake listing image, cut out, keeping the drip and fork device.

issues.what: The fork and drip stream are thin and look detached from the heel tip, and read weakly at thumbnail size.
issues.fix_in_canva: Thicken the red stream where it meets the heel tip so heel-to-fork reads as one continuous melt.

issues.what: Logo top edge sits at about 110px, right at the limit.
issues.fix_in_canva: Move the logo up 10–15px so its top edge sits at about 95–100px.

strengths: The heel-to-pitchfork melt device carries over clearly
Headline stays plain and readable, stacked like the reference
Generous white space and a clean right-hand text column
